description.value: Requires: 5 ranks of Ultra Instinct Mastery Feat and Mastered Ultra Instinct. You have stopped considering Ultra Instinct Omen as a Form, now considering it truly as part of your base without any of the drawbacks. You may now go into Ultra Instinct Omen at will. Additionally Ultra Instinct Omen no longer has a Stamina Upkeep.
